name: Pendo
description: Pendo is a product-experience and digital-adoption platform for Pages, Features, Track Events, Guides, Product Areas, Visitors, Accounts, Session Replay, Feedback, and behavioral analytics.
agentUseSummary: Enter a dedicated customer-owned Engage Integration Key created without write access, the exact US, EU, US1, Japan, or Australia API origin, and one numeric Application ID. Relay validates the subscription-wide key, pins every data request to that Application, and exposes only 25-item redacted Page/Feature/Guide inventories plus one fixed adoption percentage over at most 31 days; records, private content, detailed analytics, MCP, arbitrary aggregation, exports, and writes remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: PENDO_ENGAGE_API_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: Pendo Engage API origin
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact Pendo UI/API origin for the subscription: US, EU, US1, Japan, or Australia. Relay rejects every other origin.

credentialRequirements.name: PENDO_APPLICATION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Pendo Application ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact numeric Application ID from Application settings. Relay applies it to every definition and adoption request even though the Integration Key is subscription-wide.

credentialRequirements.name: PENDO_INTEGRATION_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Pendo read-only Integration Key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated Engage Integration Key with Allow Write Access left off. The key is shown once, is not user-bound, and can access all Applications and environments in the subscription.

capabilities.label: Application boundary
capabilities.description: Validate one regional read-only Integration Key and configured Application ID.

capabilities.label: Product definitions
capabilities.description: List bounded redacted Page, Feature, and Guide summaries.

capabilities.label: Adoption aggregate
capabilities.description: Read one bounded fixed Application-adoption percentage.

allowed.label: Read Application boundary
allowed.description: Validate the exact regional Engage API origin and subscription-wide read-only Integration Key, and report the configured Application ID.

allowed.label: List product definitions
allowed.description: List at most 25 redacted Page, Feature, or Guide summaries for the configured Application.

allowed.label: Read Application adoption
allowed.description: Read one fixed Application-level adoption percentage over an explicit range of at most 31 days.

blocked.label: Access Visitors or Accounts
blocked.description: Visitor and Account records, IDs, metadata, histories, Segments and membership, classified data, and person-level activity are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access private definition content
blocked.description: Page rules, Feature rules, Guide descriptions/content/steps/audiences/polls/localization, creator identities, URLs, and private metadata are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access detailed analytics
blocked.description: Raw Events, arbitrary aggregations, reports, Paths, Funnels, Workflows, Retention, Data Explorer, Session Replay, Feedback, NPS responses, logs, exports, and Data Sync are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change Pendo data
blocked.description: Creating, updating, publishing, resetting, importing, ingesting, deleting, or otherwise changing Pendo data is outside V1; the Integration Key must be created without Allow Write Access.

blocked.label: Use broader Pendo transports
blocked.description: Interactive MCP/OAuth, service-account Client Credentials, Feedback APIs, arbitrary origins/paths/pipelines/queries, pagination, crawling, synchronization, and raw API access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Three bounded Application reads run automatically; records, private definition content, detailed analytics, broader transports, arbitrary access, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same three read-only tools run while exact region/Application binding, fixed requests, short ranges, audit, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts three bounded Pendo Engage wrappers and attaches the encrypted read-only Integration Key, validated region, and configured Application ID server-side.

providerSetup.nextAction: A customer Pendo admin confirms Engage API access, creates a dedicated Integration Key with Allow Write Access left off, records the one-time value, and supplies the exact subscription region plus numeric Application ID.

evidence.supports: Pendo documents the x-pendo-integration-key header, regional origins, token verification, Application filtering for Page/Feature/Guide reads, fixed adoption aggregation, status codes, and the broader sensitive API surface Relay blocks.
Pendo documents plan/admin dependencies, one-time Integration Key display, non-user-bound subscription-wide access across Applications and environments, and key creation/management.
Pendo documents exact regional API origins and explicit appId filtering for multi-Application subscriptions.
Pendo separately documents interactive regional MCP/OAuth access; Relay excludes this broader transport from the Integration-Key V1.
